== English errata comparison sources ==
The Players Committee’s dated post changes the lightsaber trigger to when the character is about to be hit. The complete D-E1 face and Appendix A reproduce the new wording. Both English faces are Immediate Effects. The Decipher and later Appendix B statements about an unattended captive with no escort are rulings.

Aglets, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1322117#p1322117 Current Rulings and Errata], Players Committee, 25 November 2020. The post makes the Appendix A replacement effective immediately. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=103|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 103. [[:File:CC-D-alltooeasy.gif|Complete replacement face]]. Earlier ruling: Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=12|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 12. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=137|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix B, PDF page 137.
